Commentary.Commentary: India will be disappointed, to say the least. They had the game under the control but let it slip. 80 runs came in the last 6 overs and that is hard to say why. If there is dew, then the hosts will be happy because the Windies will have to bear the brunt of it. If no, then this is a very big total on a sluggish pitch. Chahal was the pick of the bowlers with 2/28 in 4 overs. Stay tuned for the run chase.

The Windies targetted Krunal Pandya in the 15th over and the Indian struggled to contain. Was it dew? Not sure. Every bowler was taken to the cleaners and as a result, Bravo and Pooran finished an unbeaten stand of 87 from 43 balls. Both played brilliantly but the latter was exceptional, with 53 from just 25 balls, playing paddles, reverse paddles, switch hits, everything.

India started things off pretty quietly, not giving away too many runs but then Hope and Hetmyer started to counter-attack. They added 51 for the opening wicket but once the stand was broken, India started to come back. The Windies could manage only 50 runs for the loss of 3 wickets since the Powerplay in 8 overs. However, after that, the carnage started.
Unbelievable hitting. Pooran has just blown the Indian bowlers away. The bowling lacked discipline in the last few overs and was punished.
Another reverse sweep played, this time not quite cleanly. It is mistimed towards point. A single taken. 23 from the over, WINDIES FINISH ON 181/3!
FOUR! Intelligent batting! A full toss outside leg, Pooran reverse sweeps it over short third man for a boundary!
SIX! IMPERIOUS! A short ball, around middle, Pooran pulls it with disdain over square leg!
FOUR! Short of a length outside off, Pooran backs away and slashes it over cover for a boundary!
A slower delivery, Nicholas misses his flick.
WIDE. Full and down the leg side, Darren misses his flick. A bye taken.
SIX! What a hit! A full toss on middle, Bravo swings it over mid-wicket for a biggie!
A full toss, on middle, flicked towards long on for a run.
Down the leg side, would have been a wide, but Pooran somehow manages to get bat to it and earns a single towards fine leg.
On middle and leg, flicked towards fine leg for one.
Full and outside leg, Nicholas attempts the reverse paddle again but mistimes it towards point. A run taken.

REVERSE PADDLE, DROPPED, FOUR! Rohit Sharma is not happy. Yuzvendra Chahal is the fielder. Full and around leg, Pooran brings out the reverse paddle but hits it towards backward point. Chahal jumps a bit too early and the ball bursts through his hands to the point fence.
Full and around off, pushed towards long on for a single.
Bhuvi to bowl again.
Full on middle, pushed towards long on for a single.
The batsman fails to put bat on ball.
A short ball, Bravo swings this with one hand. The ball goes towards deep mid-wicket and Lokesh Rahul makes a good stop in the deep. Two runs taken.
The batsman was too slow to move his boot out of the way.
Outside off, Bravo looks to cut but misses.
Full and around off, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Khaleel Ahmed is back on.
Thick inside edge by the batsman, ball goes down to fine leg. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Short and outside off, Pooran looks to cut but gets a bottom edge behind. A quick single taken.
Short and outside off, NP cuts it through the covers for a couple.
WIDE. Another one. Down the leg side again, flick shot missed once more.
WIDE. Down the leg side, Nicholas looks to flick but misses.
SIX! The switch hit! What a shot. Fractionally short outside leg, Pooran reverses his stance, changes his grip and gets it over cover!
Yuzvendra Chahal to bowl out. 3-0-15-2 so far.
Full and outside off, pushed towards mid off for one. 15 from the over, 31 from the last 2!
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Excellent yorker, dug out to the off side for a single.

SIX! This is a miscue too but the result is the same! Full and outside off, Pooran looks to clear long off this time. Again, the connection is not that great. Gets more height than distance but has enough to clear long off in the end!
SIX! Seemed like a miscue but it has sailed over! A length ball, around off, Pooran looks to pull but the bounce does him in. Gets a bit of a top edge but the ball has enough on it to clear long on!
Outside off, a play and a miss.
Short and outside off, well outside the guidelines, Bravo looks to cut but misses. This is not signalled a wide though. 16 from the over, Krunal finishes with figures of 4-0-40-0!
SIX! Solid hit! Full and wide outside off, Bravo reaches out and lofts it over long off!
Full and wide outside off, Bravo looks to loft it over long off but miscues it due to lack of pace. Gets a couple as the ball lands short of wide long off.
FOUR! Full and around off, Bravo bludgeons it past the bowler for a boundary towards long on.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
Outside off, pushed to cover for a single.
WIDE. Harsh call. Fired outside off, Bravo lets it go but the ball was inside the guidelines.
WIDE. Landed outside off, left alone.
Krunal Pandya is back on. 3-0-24-0 so far.
FOUR! Nice way to end the over. Full and wide outside off, Pooran reaches out and slashes it though point to find the boundary!
Goes back and works it through square leg for a single.
This time the outside edge is found, as Pooran looks to defend but the ball goes past the keeper towards short third man. A run taken.

Smart bowling. Holds the ball as if he is going to bowl seam-up but at the last moment, he changes it to an off cutter. The ball lands, grips and then moves away to square Pooran up. Beats the outside edge.
The knuckle ball, outside off, Pooran looks to steer it towards third man but is beaten.
Around off, defended to the off side.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar returns. 1-0-9-0 so far.
Short and outside off, slapped to sweeper cover for a run. A slightly expensive outing for Sundar tonight. 4-0-33-1.
Nicholas Pooran comes in at number 5, replacing Ramdin.
OUT! BOWLED! Sundar finally gets a wicket. A touch short outside off, Ramdin looks to cut but the ball spins in, takes the inside edge and hits the stumps!
Landed outside off, spinning in, cut straight to cover.
WIDE. Thrown up wide outside off, Denesh slashes but misses.
SIX! HUMONGOUS! Comes down the track, does Ramdin, gets to the pitch of the ball and swings it over mid-wicket!
Full and down the leg side, Ramdin looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
The batsman has played it to the point region for a single.
WIDE. Down the leg side, Ramdin looks to hit it away but misses. Karthik cannot collect and the batsmen take a single.
Here's Washington Sundar again. 3-0-22-0 so far.
Plays this early again and the ball lobs over the man at short mid-wicket. A single to long on.

DROPPED! That should have been taken. On middle, Ramdin looks to push it down to long on but ends up hitting it a bit too early. The ball lobs in the air, straight back to the bowler who leaps to his left but cannot catch it.
Takes this on the full and whacks it towards long on for another single.
WIDE. Miles outside off, Bravo walks across and lets it go.
Outside off, punched down to long on for one.
Short and outside off, slapped to deep point for a run.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR LEG BYES! Plenty of turn. Landed outside off, Bravo goes back and looks to cut but the ball spins in a mile, goes off something, misses the leg stump and also beats the keeper to the fine leg fence. Replays show that missed everything. Hit nothing.
Works it through mid-wicket for a run.
On middle and leg, flicked through the leg side for a single.
FOUR! HAMMERED! Full and outside off, tossed up a bit, Bravo reaches out and smashes it over mid off. Lokesh Rahul is a bit too wide at long off and cannot get there! Bravo moves to 11 from 14 balls.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Full on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Short and outside off, worked towards long on for a single.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads for a couple of runs.
Full on middle, Ramdin looks to flick but gets a bit of a leading edge. Does not carry to the bowler.
Outside off, pushed through the covers for a run.
Gets across and laps this towards fine leg for a single.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Denesh Ramdin is the new man in. Krunal Pandya is back on. 1-0-13-0 so far.

OUT! There goes Hetmyer and Chahal has his second in as many overs. Short and outside of, the googly again, Hetmyer rocks back and tries to cut it through the off side but is done in by the extra bounce. Mistimes his cut and the direction too. Wants to go over point but finds Krunal Pandya at sweeper cover instead. A promising innings cut short.
Pushes this towards cover for a single.
Short and outside off, cut through the covers for a run.
This time he plays it with soft hands towards point for a quick single.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
The wrong 'un, outside off, short n length, cut straight to short extra cover.
LEADING EDGE, SAFE!  Full on middle, Hetmyer looks to flick but gets a leading edge. The bowler comes running ahead but the ball lands short of him!
On middle and leg, flicked away for a run.
Short and outside off, cut straight to cover.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Pushes this down the ground towards long on for a run.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover for a quick single.
Washington Sundar is back on. 2-0-19-0 so far.
Short and outside off, cut through the covers for one.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
Outside off, punched off the back foot for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Dropped short, pulled away for a single.
WIDE. Well outside off, left alone.
Darren Bravo comes in at number 3, replacing Hope.

OUT! Caught! Chahal has struck with his very first ball. Probably not the smartest of shots from Hope. He could have waited for a few balls. Full and around middle, Hope gets down and plays the slog sweep. But the connection is not the sweetest. He gets more height than distance. Is caught by Washington Sundar at deep mid-wicket. End of a quick opening stand.
Yuzvendra Chahal introduced now.
SIX! Excellent timing. Full and around off, Hetmyer leans and lofts it straight back over the bowler. It lands full on the ropes! 51/0 IN THE POWERPLAY!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Short and outside off, Hetmyer looks to cut but misses.

BRILLIANT EFFORT! Dhawan has saved 5 runs. A short ball, Shai goes back and pulls it over mid-wicket. For a second, it seems like it will clear the ropes but Shikhar Dhawan leaps at the last moment, leaps and parries the ball back in! A single taken.
SIX! FETCH THAT! Slightly short on off, Hope comes forward and swings it over mid-wicket!
Outside off, played straight to point.
Krunal Pandya is on now.
Around off, worked wide of mid on for a quick single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
FOUR! Attacking stroke! A length ball outside off, Hope comes down the track and lofts it cleanly, with a high elbow, over mid off!
Outside off, played straight to point.
A slower delivery. SH looks to pull but is early and gets a thick inside edge onto his pads.
FOUR! Bad start. On a length and around middle, Hope pulls it over short fine leg for a boundary! The stand moves to 33 from 25 balls. Shai moves to 12 from 13 balls with his second boundary.
Here comes Bhuvi.
The ball strikes the batsman very low on the pads. 14 from the over!
FIVE WIDES! Sundar losing his line, bowls it well down the leg side, Hetmyer looks to pull this but misses. Dinesh Karthik behind is blinded and cannot collect.
FOUR! Another cracking shot. Full and wide outside off, Hetmyer gives himself room to the leg side and crashes it through the covers for the second boundary of the over!
The batsman has played it to the point region.
FOUR! FEROCIOUS! Dropped short, around middle, Hetmyer backs away and pulls it over the bowler for a boundary!

MISUNDERSTANDING, BUT SAFE! Short and outside off, Hetmyer cuts it through point. Initially calls for the single but then realizes that it is to the left of the left-handed Khaleel AHMED. Sends Hope back who has come a bit too far. He dives into the crease but  direct hit from Khaleel would have made things interesting.
Full and around off, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.

FOUR! This is what can happen when there is a left hand-right hand combination at the crease. Khaleel is struggling slightly in terms of controlling his line. This ball would have been good to Hope but for Hetmyer, it is a length delivery on the pads. Whipped over a leaping short fine leg.
On middle and leg, helped through square leg for a single.
FOUR! Another good shot. A length ball again, wider outside off, Hope hits this on the up, over cover and gets a boundary. The stand moves to 10 from 15 balls.
Beautifully bowled. Landing on a length outside off, Hope looks to steer this towards third man but the ball holds its line and whizzes past the outside edge.
A touch short outside off, punched straight to short cover.
The arm ball to end the over, following the batsman down the leg side, Shimron backs away and looks to flick but misses and is hit on the groin.
Outside off, steered straight to short third man.
Full and straight, watchfully defended.
FOUR! Good shot. That is not a bad ball at all. Slightly shorter than full, Hetmyer goes deep in his crease and helps it through square leg for a boundary.
Bowls this with a little bit of different actin, slightly slingy action, darts this on middle, it is pushed towards long on for a single.
Around off, pushed towards short mid-wicket.
Washington Sundar to bowl from the other end.
Full and outside off, pushed towards point. A decent start from Khaleel.
On middle and leg, flicked towards mid-wicket for a quick single. The Windies are away.
Around middle, swinging in, tucked towards short mid-wicket.
Comes forward and drives it towards mid off.

Earlier, Yuzvendra Chahal had a chat with Laxman Sivaramakrishnan. The former says that his performance in the Ranji Trophy has helped him a great deal. The mindset, in particular favoured him to have success. Adds that in the Indian T20 League, doing well on smaller grounds gave him immense confidence to do better in bigger grounds outside India. Adds that in one season, he got hit for around 28 sixes but he does not mind that as long as he is able to pick up wickets. Praises Virat Kohli for trusting him and giving him the responsibility to bowl in any situation.
Full and around off, no pace at all in this pitch, the ball barely bounces upto the knee, Hope comes forward and defends.
Around off, watchfully defended.

Alright. Time to get going. The players are out in the middle. Shimron Hetmyer and Shai Hope will start off proceedings for the Windies. Interesting choice from Rohit Sharma. He has not gone for Washington Sundar but preferred Khaleel Ahmed instead. Hope to face. Here we go!

Indian captain, Rohit Sharma, says that he would have bowled well since India are playing with a long batting line-up. Reckons that the pitch will not change much over the course of 40 overs but also says that it all boils down to how well they play. Informs that the hosts have brought in Yuzvendra Chahal and Washington Sundar in place of Kuldeep Yadav and Jasprit Bumrah. Is glad with the youngsters shaping up to play cricket for India. On this dead rubber, Sharma says that this is a great opportunity for those who have not played much. On his own batting and scoring another century, Rohit says that he will try his best but he is not interested in records and wants to focus more on how the team performs.

Windies skipper, Carlos Brathwaite, says that history suggests that majority teams winning the toss here have batted first. Says that he is playing here for the first time but has observed that the pitch tends to slow down as the game progresses. On the advice given to his boys, Carlos says that every member of the team is lucky to be here, representing their country and there are plenty of things to play for - pride, careers, etc... Hopes to show the same intensity and hunger as they had before they embarked on this tour. Informs that they are going with an unchanged XI from the previous game.
TOSS TIME! Rohit Sharma flips the coin, Heads is the call and Heads it is. WINDIES WILL BAT FIRST.

Sunil Gavaskar doing the pitch report says that the pitch here in 1978 was the fastest he has ever played on. But reckons that this is nowhere close to that one. Observes the surface as a dry one with plenty of cracks. Adds that the ball will skid through as well. Feels that the dew might kick in as the evening goes deep but also says that does not matter as far as India are concerned.

White-ball cricket is Windies' strength. They showed that during the second and third ODIs. But since then, India have not allowed them to be competitive at all. Even in the first 2 T20Is, they have rolled them over and there is nothing in the opposition camp which suggests that tonight will be any different. The hosts are without Jasprit Bumrah and Kuldeep Yadav and the visitors will hope that it helps them to some extent.

Hello people! Wishing one and all a Happy Diwali. The festivities are still going on and being the weekend, the happiness and enjoyment is even more. Cricket makes its appearance for one final time in this country in 2018 and it is in the form of a dead rubber - the third T20I between India and Windies at the M.A.Chidambaram Stadium, Chennai. Hopefully, we get some contest.
